description: S3 directory Access Point references a same-account bucket missing from verified bucket inventory
rationale: The Access Point returned an explicit same-account bucket owner and a target absent from a completed corresponding S3 bucket enumeration. This is an inventory consistency gap; missing identities with denied, unselected or incomplete bucket APIs remain unknown. It does not prove public exposure.
remediation: Verify target bucket/account/region, S3 Control Access Point ownership and stale inventory; re-enumerate with complete AWS permissions. Reconcile or retire stale access points only after change approval.
